scripts.setup: npm --prefix functions run setup:local && npm --prefix functions install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:functions
scripts.smoke:api: node -e "fetch('http://localhost:7071/api/dashboard').then(async (r)=>{if(!r.ok) throw new Error('status '+r.status); const j=await r.json(); if(!j.recommendations?.recommendations?.length) throw new Error('missing recommendations'); console.log('OK', j.recommendations.recommendations[0].zoneName, j.recommendations.recommendations[0].score);}).catch((e)=>{console.error(e); process.exit(1);})"
